scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Barrier Net and its Accessories
other_conditions: The applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
The applicant must be a resident of Goa.
The applicant must have purchased a Barrier Net and its Accessories.
The scheme can be availed by a beneficiary once every 4 years.
Applications are accepted only in offline mode.
benefits_summary: Subsidy of 50% up to ₹30,000 for general category and 60% up to ₹36,000 for SC/ST/Woman category on barrier net purchase.
documents_required: self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents (if required)
